info.description: The API behind the ekPanel web interface. Authenticate with an API token (Account → API tokens) sent as `Authorization: Bearer ekp_…`. A token acts as its owner, limited by its scopes; `x-ekpanel-scope` on each operation names the scope it needs. Errors are JSON: `{"code": "…", "message": "…"}`. Request and response schemas are not described yet.
